name: new-vacation
title_zh: 采访式录入 GPX 与兴趣点，新假期一次成型
tagline_zh: 不用学后台，不用碰短代码。它像导游一样逐站问你：GPX 文件、每日分段、休息点命名、兴趣点、相机设置。
tagline_en: No admin digging, no shortcodes. It walks you stop-by-stop: GPX files, day splits, break names, POIs, camera—then.
desc_en: Interview-driven workflow to add a new vacation (or redo an existing one) to the vacation3d WordPress plugin — collect GPX files, verify the day split, name the breaks, collect POIs, choose the camera, build, deploy. Use when the user says "new vacation", "neuer Urlaub", "add a trip", "add GPX", or wants to change POIs/breaks of an existing vacation.
why_zh: 把「新增假期」从手工填表变成一次结构化访谈，每步校验数据完整性，避免漏传 GPX 或分段错位。
why_en: Turns 'add a vacation' from manual form-filling into a structured interview, validating each step so no GPX or day-split.
limit_zh: 只服务 vacation3d 插件，且需 WordPress 站点已装好并配好部署通道。不处理 GPX 文件内容本身。
limit_en: Only for the vacation3d plugin with a configured WordPress deploy channel. It collects/validates GPX paths, not file contents; halts before deploy.
title_en: Interview-driven GPX & POI entry for a new vacation
